_readme: Per-model rates for cost-per-success reporting. See src/codeagent_eval/pricing.py.
An entry yields a cost only when prompt_per_1k, completion_per_1k, source and as_of are
all present. Anything else reports cost_source=unavailable rather than 0.0, because a
zero is indistinguishable from 'this was free' everywhere it is later displayed.
To price a model: copy the figures from the vendor's official pricing page, put that
page's URL in 'source' and the date you read it in 'as_of', then bump 'revision'. The
revision is recorded in every run's artifacts, so a cost figure stays traceable to the
rates that produced it even after prices change.
CNY-priced models additionally need a top-level 'usd_per_cny'. Without it the entry
reports unavailable: no exchange rate is ever assumed.

models.note: Cache-hit input is billed separately; fill cached_prompt_per_1k or the estimate becomes an upper bound.
Reasoning tokens are billed as output.
open.bigmodel.cn publishes CNY; the z.ai endpoint publishes USD. Set currency to match the endpoint actually used.
